title: The Jukebox
body: Join a voice channel and use its embedded chat. /play searches the owner-authorized direct-audio catalog. External service links provide metadata references only: a track must match an enabled authorized catalog item to play. The controller distinguishes pending requests from confirmed playback.

fields.query: Search the authorized catalog or provide a supported metadata reference. Unmatched recordings are unavailable; no silent substitute is played.
fields.time: Seek within the current supported recording.
fields.position: Use the current queue or playlist position.
fields.name: Your own playlist name.

steps: Join a voice channel and open its embedded text chat.
Search with /play and choose an available authorized recording.
Confirm duplicates when prompted; check pending versus confirmed playback on the controller.
Skip your own track, use DJ authority, or vote with eligible listeners. Previous, Replay and Seek require the current requester or a DJ.
Save your own playlists. Deleting a playlist does not remove tracks already queued.
